completion:
Clearly state the advertised specifications for the product.
3. Methodically document the testing procedure that was used to verify the advertised specifications.
4. Detail the results of the tests, highlighting the areas where the product failed to meet its advertised specifications.
5. Provide specific measurements, figures, and data to support your findings.
6. Include the date of testing, name of the tester, and any relevant contact information.
7. Compare your findings with the manufacturer’s claims objectively.
8. Offer potential reasons for the discrepancies between the advertised specifications and the actual performance.
9. Include photographs, charts, or videos that illustrate the performance discrepancies if applicable.
10. Ensure all cited data is clear and precise, and present it in a structured, easily understandable format.
11. If any part of the advertised specifications was confirmed to be accurate, document this as well for completeness.
12. Prepare a conclusion that summarizes the key points of the report and reiterates the areas of
